The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] utilized an experimental '''long-range scanner/decoder''' to spy on the [[Imperial Communications Center (Iyuta)|Imperial Communications Center]] on [[Iyuta]]. [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]]' [[Green squad]] were tasked with the mission to report on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] activity in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="LRIM" />
